subject.title: [Bug]: Discord media uploads lose content-type and animated images lose frames

question: Should maintainers refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41265 as the canonical fix for Discord media MIME/WebP preservation, or replace it with a new narrow branch?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the linked branch is open, conflicting, and proof-blocked, so branch ownership and adoption versus replacement need maintainer judgment.

options.title: Refresh the linked PR
options.body: Keep the contributor PR as canonical, resolve conflicts and proof gaps, and close this issue only after it merges.

options.title: Replace with a narrow PR
options.body: Open a fresh current-main fix that preserves the useful behavior and credits the source work before superseding the linked branch.

options.title: Leave parked
options.body: Keep the issue open without a new repair lane until a maintainer is ready to sponsor the Discord media fix.

recommendation.title: Refresh the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep the contributor PR as canonical, resolve conflicts and proof gaps, and close this issue only after it merges.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across the Discord send helper and media optimization surfaces involved in the branch decision.
